entries.title: Themes admin list showing Agency.
entries.notes: Capture after installing capell-app/theme-agency with Foundation Theme and creating an Agency theme record in the isolated demo harness.
entries.useCase: An administrator sees the Agency theme record in the host Themes admin surface.

entries.title: Signed admin preview route.
entries.notes: Capture a temporary signed preview URL generated from the host Themes table for the Agency theme.
entries.useCase: An administrator opens a preview URL to inspect a page with the Agency theme applied.

entries.title: Frontend page rendered with Agency theme.
entries.notes: Capture the isolated demo route that renders navigation, hero, features, proof, content listing, CTA, and footer through the Agency renderer.
entries.useCase: A visitor sees a seeded public page rendered through every Agency theme section.

entries.title: Agency homepage.
entries.notes: Capture the basic creative campaign homepage with launch-room hero, campaign proof, work-in-progress cards, and conversion CTA.
entries.useCase: A creative team reviews the free Agency preset as a campaign launch surface, not a premium case-study portfolio.

entries.title: Services page.
entries.notes: Capture the campaign services page with creative routes, delivery steps, team proof, and launch CTA.
entries.useCase: A studio or campaign team checks that services stay focused on campaign delivery rather than broad consulting.

entries.title: Campaign work board.
entries.notes: Capture campaign work cards, channel filters, and a featured launch snapshot. Requires capell-app/content-sections; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A buyer sees recent campaign assets without Agency overlapping Portfolio's premium case-file workflow.

entries.title: Launch recap detail.
entries.notes: Capture a compact launch recap with brief, creative route, channel assets, and lightweight metrics. Requires capell-app/media-library; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A campaign team can show delivery proof while leaving deep outcome-led case studies to Portfolio.

entries.title: Insights article.
entries.notes: Capture a campaign insight article with author details, related reads, and launch-room CTA. Requires capell-app/blog; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A creative team checks that editorial content supports campaigns instead of becoming a knowledge-base theme.

entries.title: Event landing page.
entries.notes: Capture a launch event page with agenda, speakers, creative assets, and registration CTA. Requires capell-app/events; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A campaign team can promote launches and webinars without requiring a premium SaaS or Events-specific layout.

entries.title: Lead generation page.
entries.notes: Capture a campaign brief form with offer copy, qualification fields, and confirmation state. Requires capell-app/form-builder; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A creative team checks that the preset converts campaign interest into a usable brief.

entries.title: Campaign page.
entries.notes: Capture a campaign page with variant hero, launch sections, asset blocks, and analytics hooks. Requires capell-app/campaign-studio; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A buyer sees Agency's strongest lane: fast campaign and launch pages with basic creative polish.

entries.title: Search results page.
entries.notes: Capture campaign search with grouped launch assets, highlighted terms, and recovery state. Requires capell-app/search; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A visitor can find campaigns, briefs, and resources without the page feeling like Knowledge's archive search.
